lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: aap chhadaae chhuteeai satigur charan samaal ||4||
lines.translation: If the Lord Himself saves you, then you shall be saved. Dwell upon the Feet of the True Guru. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man karahalaa mere piaariaa vich dehee jot samaal ||
lines.translation: O my dear beloved camel-like mind, dwell upon the Divine Light within the body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਦਇਆਲਿ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: gur nau nidh naam vikhaaliaa har daat karee daiaal ||5||
lines.translation: The Guru has shown me the nine treasures of the Naam. The Merciful Lord has bestowed this gift. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਚੰਚਲਾ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਛਡਿ ਵਿਕਰਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man karahalaa too(n) cha(n)chalaa chaturaaee chhad vikaraal ||
lines.translation: O camel-like mind, you are so fickle; give up your cleverness and corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam samaal too(n) har mukat kare a(n)t kaal ||6||
lines.translation: Dwell upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; at the very last moment, the Lord shall liberate you. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਤੂੰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man karahalaa vadabhaageeaa too(n) giaan ratan samaal ||
lines.translation: O camel-like mind, you are so very fortunate; dwell upon the jewel of spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਖੜਗੁ ਹਥਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿਅੜਾ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: gur giaan khaRag hath dhaariaa jam maariaRaa jamakaal ||7||
lines.translation: You hold in your hands the sword of the Guru's spiritual wisdom; with this destroyer of death, kill the Messenger of Death. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭਵਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar nidhaan man karahale bhram bhavahi baahar bhaal ||
lines.translation: The treasure is deep within, O camel-like mind, but you wander around outside in doubt, searching for it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਲਧੜਾ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: gur purakh pooraa bhetiaa har sajan ladhaRaa naal ||8||
lines.translation: Meeting the Perfect Guru, the Primal Being, you shall discover that the Lord, your Best Friend, is with you. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੜੇ ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ra(n)g rataRe man karahale har ra(n)g sadaa samaal ||
lines.translation: You are engrossed in pleasures, O camel-like mind; dwell upon the Lord's lasting love instead!

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: har ra(n)g kade na utarai gur sevaa sabad samaal ||9||
lines.translation: The color of the Lord's Love never fades away; serve the Guru, and dwell upon the Word of the Shabad. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਪੰਖੀ ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਕਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham pa(n)khee man karahale har taravar purakh akaal ||
lines.translation: We are birds, O camel-like mind; the Lord, the Immortal Primal Being, is the tree.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧੦॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: vadabhaagee guramukh paaiaa jan naanak naam samaal ||10||2||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs are very fortunate - they find it. O servant Nanak, dwell upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||10||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag gauRee guaareree mahalaa 5 asatapadeeaa ||
lines.translation: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਤ ਗੁਮਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab ihu man mahi karat gumaanaa ||
lines.translation: When this mind is filled with pride,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਇਹੁ ਬਾਵਰੁ ਫਿਰਤ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tab ihu baavar phirat bigaanaa ||
lines.translation: then it wanders around like a madman and a lunatic.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਹੂਆ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਰੀਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab ihu hooaa sagal kee reenaa ||
lines.translation: But when it becomes the dust of all,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਰਮਈਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: taa te ramaeeaa ghat ghat cheenaa ||1||
lines.translation: then it recognizes the Lord in each and every heart. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਫਲੁ ਮਸਕੀਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj suhelaa phal masakeenee ||
lines.translation: The fruit of humility is intuitive peace and pleasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur apunai mohi daan deenee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My True Guru has given me this gift. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab kis kau ihu jaanas ma(n)daa ||
lines.translation: When he believes others to be bad,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਸਗਲੇ ਇਸੁ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਫੰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tab sagale is melahi pha(n)daa ||
lines.translation: then everyone lays traps for him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰ ਤੇਰ ਜਬ ਇਨਹਿ ਚੁਕਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mer ter jab inahi chukaaee ||
lines.translation: But when he stops thinking in terms of 'mine' and 'yours',

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਇਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਹੀ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: taa te is sa(n)g nahee bairaaee ||2||
lines.translation: then no one is angry with him. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਇਨਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਅਪਨੀ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab in apunee apanee dhaaree ||
lines.translation: When he clings to 'my own, my own',

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਇਸ ਕਉ ਹੈ ਮੁਸਕਲੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: tab is kau hai musakal bhaaree ||
lines.translation: then he is in deep trouble.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਇਨਿ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab in karanaihaar pachhaataa ||
lines.translation: But when he recognizes the Creator Lord,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਇਸ ਨੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tab is no naahee kichh taataa ||3||
lines.translation: then he is free of torment. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਇਨਿ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਮੋਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab in apuno baadhio mohaa ||
lines.translation: When he entangles himself in emotional attachment,

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਜਮਿ ਜੋਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavai jaai sadaa jam johaa ||
lines.translation: he comes and goes in reincarnation, under the constant gaze of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਇਸ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab is te sabh binase bharamaa ||
lines.translation: But when all his doubts are removed,

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੇਦੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਹੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: bhed naahee hai paarabrahamaa ||4||
lines.translation: then there is no difference between him and the Supreme Lord God. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਇਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੇ ਭੇਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab in kichh kar maane bhedaa ||
lines.translation: When he perceives differences,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਤੇ ਦੂਖ ਡੰਡ ਅਰੁ ਖੇਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tab te dookh da(n)d ar khedaa ||
lines.translation: then he suffers pain, punishment and sorrow.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਇਨਿ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੀ ਬੂਝਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab in eko ekee boojhiaa ||
lines.translation: But when he recognizes the One and Only Lord,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਤੇ ਇਸ ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: tab te is no sabh kichh soojhiaa ||5||
lines.translation: he understands everything. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਧਾਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਰਥੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab ihu dhaavai maaiaa arathee ||
lines.translation: When he runs around for the sake of Maya and riches,

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ਨਹ ਤਿਸ ਲਾਥੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: nah tripataavai nah tis laathee ||
lines.translation: he is not satisfied, and his desires are not quenched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਇਸ ਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਹੋਇਓ ਜਉਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab is te ihu hoio jaulaa ||
lines.translation: But when he runs away from Maya,

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੀਛੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਚਲੀ ਉਠਿ ਕਉਲਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: peechhai laag chalee uth kaulaa ||6||
lines.translation: then the Goddess of Wealth gets up and follows him. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa jau satigur milio ||
lines.translation: When, by His Grace, the True Guru is met,

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਜਲਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: man ma(n)dar mahi deepak jalio ||
lines.translation: the lamp is lit within the temple of the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਤ ਹਾਰ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਕਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeet haar kee sojhee karee ||
lines.translation: When he realizes what victory and defeat really are,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਇਸੁ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਰੀ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: tau is ghar kee keemat paree ||7||
lines.translation: then he comes to appreciate the true value of his own home. ||7||
